name: catalogfitsfilter-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: catalogFitsFilter (pro) flag gate + a real interaction. The checkbox only renders while NOT searching (hidden by the drawer's `!q && fFitsFilter` guard) — so this browses the 'Beds' category instead of using search. Simple/Pro gate on the catalog 'Fits only' checkbox; browsing the too-big Queen bed in a small bathroom shows it with the filter off, and the checkbox hides it once turned on.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: catalogFitsFilter should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-no-fits-only-checkbox-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.cat-fits-only'); if (el) throw new Error('Fits only checkbox should not render in Simple mode'); })()

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: catalogFitsFilter should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: fits-only-checkbox-visible
steps.failMessage: 'Fits only' checkbox did not appear in Pro mode while browsing (not searching)

steps.name: assert-queen-bed-present-before-filter
steps.failMessage: Queen bed card should still show its 'Won't fit' badge (unfiltered) before turning Fits-only on

steps.name: toggle-fits-only-on
steps.eval: (() => { const cb = document.querySelector('.cat-fits-only input[type=checkbox]'); if (!cb) throw new Error('checkbox not found'); if (cb.checked) throw new Error('expected unchecked before toggling'); cb.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-queen-bed-hidden
steps.failMessage: 'Fits only' did not hide the too-big Queen bed card

steps.name: toggle-fits-only-off
steps.eval: (() => { const cb = document.querySelector('.cat-fits-only input[type=checkbox]'); if (!cb) throw new Error('checkbox not found'); if (!cb.checked) throw new Error('expected checked before toggling off'); cb.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-queen-bed-back
steps.failMessage: Turning Fits-only back off should re-show the too-big Queen bed card
